summary: Tinode is a self-hosted instant messaging server (Go): a WebSocket/long-poll/GRPC chat backend whose store persists users, auth credentials, topics, subscriptions, messages, deletion logs, device push tokens, file uploads and a KV metadata table across pluggable SQL (postgres/mysql) or NoSQL (rethinkdb/mongodb) adapters.
